alerts.title: Viral Load Monitoring
alerts.message: Guidelines recommend checking viral load every 6 months for patients on DTG-based first-line ART. Patient's last viral load was 129 days before the visit, which is within the recommended timeframe. However, the next viral load check is due soon.
